caption: Supplementary Fig. 26 | Environmental associations with wind change in bridges and resolution. a, Resolution-minus-bridge differences in environmental slopes for subsequent 6 h wind change, in kt per actual main-model sample SD. The six factors are SST, 200–850-hPa shear, mid-level RH, 200-hPa divergence, 500-hPa ascent and hemisphere-signed 850-hPa vorticity. Whiskers are marginal 95% SID-percentile intervals from 2,000 estimable draws. b, SID-cluster/normal P values, Benjamini–Hochberg q values for the six-test H2 family and independent SID counts (120 or 122). All q values exceed 0.05; P/q inference is separate from the percentile intervals. c,d, The same factors under unrestricted and tropical-endpoint (c) or sea-and-tropical-endpoint (d) eligibility. Both observations at t and t + 6 h must satisfy the rule. Tropical samples contain 118–120 SIDs; sea-and-tropical samples contain 81. These sensitivities use fixed v3.1 environmental reference SDs, whereas a uses main-model sample SDs. Weights are inverse SID-by-state observation counts after filtering. Intervals in c,d are descriptive 95% SID percentiles without an additional BH family. Table S11 and source tables retain factor-specific counts and the eligible populations.
